_readme: Machine-readable research library for Artifactory's self-learning loop.
playbook_engine.py auto-suggests entries from here whenever a playbook is
missing ([STATUS: MISSING_NEEDS_RESEARCH]) so synthesis starts from the
authoritative source instead of model memory. Categories mirror prompts/:
and learning (training grounds). Extend via PR; every URL is canonical.
